arguments.rule_content:
title: Suspicious Kerberos TGT Request from Non-DC Host
logsource:
  category: authentication
  product: windows
  service: security
  event_id: 4768
conditions:
  - event_id: 4768
  - status: failure
  - src_host: '*'
  - not dest_host: 'DC*'
  - repeat_count: '>10'
detection:
  selection:
    EventID: 4768
    Status: '0xC000006D' # NT_STATUS_WRONG_PASSWORD
    SourceNetworkAddress|cidr: '10.0.0.0/8'
    DestinationHostName: '*'
  filter:
    DestinationHostName: 'DC*'  # Exclude legitimate DC-to-DC
  condition: selection and not filter
frequency:
  field: SourceNetworkAddress
  window: 5m
  count: 10
level: high
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate user password spraying from internal tools (rare)
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1110/4/
  - https://github.com/SigmaHQ/sigma/blob/master/rules/windows/authentication/win_susp_kerberos_tgt_bruteforce.yml

rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_HTTPS_C2 {
    meta:
        description = "Detects Cobalt Strike beaconing over HTTPS with common patterns"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154/"
        date = "2026-04-11"
        hash = "e86f10bae9a8f3b1d7f5c6d4e2a1b0c8f3e9d8c7b6a5f4e3d2c1b0a9f8e7d6c5"
    strings:
        $x64_get_uri = "\/\.\.[a-zA-Z0-9]{2,4}\/[a-f0-9]{16}" wide ascii
        $x86_task_uri = "\/[a-f0-9]{8}\/[a-f0-9]{4}" wide ascii
        $user_agent = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT" wide ascii
        $cookie = "Cookie: sessionid=[a-f0-9]{32}" wide ascii
    condition:
        all of them and filesize < 500KB
}
